title: Tenstorrent Raises $1.5B to Deploy Galaxy AI Chips Globally
summary:
Tether Investments and several other institutional firms have backed Tenstorrent in a capital raise to support the manufacturing of AI hardware. Trace Capital and Innovation X led the Series E round, which raised $1.5 billion and values the AI chip startup at $6.2 billion post-money. Tenstorrent will use the funds for the global rollout of its Galaxy compute systems and to scale volume manufacturing, with further participation from Morgan Stanley, ARK Invest, Fidelity Management & Research Company, SanDisk, and Virtu Financial.

The current valuation more than doubles the company's previous $2.6 billion valuation established after it raised $700 million in December 2024. This expansion comes after Tenstorrent attracted interest from potential acquirers earlier this year as it seeks to grow its footprint in the AI compute market.

THE LATENT: AI chip startup Tenstorrent has raised $1.5 billion in Series E funding at a $6.2 billion post-money valuation, more than doubling its valuation from its previous round in December 2024.

Trace Capital and Innovation X led the round, with participation from investors including ARK Invest, Fidelity Management & Research Company, Morgan Stanley, SanDisk, Tether Investments, and Virtu Financial. Tenstorrent said the funding will support volume manufacturing and global expansion.
